description: Create, update, or delete project/group milestones. Actions: create (title + optional dates/description), update (modify properties or close/activate), delete (remove permanently), promote (elevate project milestone to group). Related: browse_milestones for progress tracking.

action.description: Action to perform: create, update, delete, promote

description.description: The new description of the milestone Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

due_date.description: The due date of the milestone (YYYY-MM-DD) Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

milestone_id.description: The ID of a project or group milestone. Required for 'update', 'delete', 'promote' action(s).

start_date.description: The start date of the milestone (YYYY-MM-DD) Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

state_event.description: State event to apply: 'close' or 'activate' Required for 'update' action(s).

title.description: The new title of the milestone Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

name: manage_milestone
